quotes.text: How old would you be if you didn't know how old you are?
quotes.author: Satchel Paige

quotes.text: The longer I live, the more beautiful life becomes.
quotes.author: Frank Lloyd Wright

quotes.text: Wrinkles should merely indicate where the smiles have been.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.text: For the ignorant, old age is winter; for the learned, it is the season of harvest.
quotes.author: Hasidic proverb

quotes.text: The best is yet to come.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: Life is a journey, not a destination.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.text: You are never too old to set another goal or to dream a new dream.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.text: The best mirror is an old friend.
quotes.author: George Herbert

quotes.text: Old age is not a defeat but a victory, not a punishment but a privilege.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: Life is 10% what happens to us and 90% how we react to it.
quotes.author: Charles R. Swindoll

quotes.text: The years teach much which the days never know.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.text: Do not go gentle into that good night. Old age should burn and rave at close of day.
quotes.author: Dylan Thomas

quotes.text: Age is opportunity no less than youth itself, though in another dress.
quotes.author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quotes.text: The greatest gift of getting older is realizing how much you don't need to prove.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: It's not what you have lost that matters, it's what you still have.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: Beautiful old people are works of art.
quotes.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

quotes.text: Growing old is mandatory. Growing up is optional.
quotes.author: Chili Davis

quotes.text: The pain of yesterday is the strength of today.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: You cannot help the birds of sadness flying over your head, but you can prevent them nesting in your hair.
quotes.author: Chinese proverb

quotes.text: The soul is healed by being with children.
quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky

quotes.text: Grow old along with me! The best is yet to be.
quotes.author: Robert Browning

quotes.text: In the sweetness of friendship let there be laughter and sharing of pleasures.
quotes.author: Khalil Gibran

quotes.text: The heart that loves is always young.
quotes.author: Greek proverb

quotes.text: You will find as you look back upon your life that the moments when you have truly lived are the moments when you have done things in the spirit of love.
quotes.author: Henry Drummond

quotes.text: Age is the acceptance of a term of years. But maturity is the glory of years.
quotes.author: Martha Graham

quotes.text: Every day is a gift. That is why it is called the present.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: Life is short. Smile while you still have teeth.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: Old age begins the day you say — I am too old for that.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: The best exercise for the heart is bending down and helping someone up.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: Do not count the years — make the years count.
quotes.author: Ernest Meyers

quotes.text: There is a fountain of youth: it is your mind, your talents, the creativity you bring to your life.
quotes.author: Sophia Loren

quotes.text: Old age is like a plane flying through a storm. Once you are aboard there is nothing you can do.
quotes.author: Golda Meir

quotes.text: You can't help getting older, but you don't have to get old.
quotes.author: George Burns

quotes.text: Getting older is no problem. You just have to live long enough.
quotes.author: Groucho Marx

quotes.text: The best classroom in the world is at the feet of an elderly person.
quotes.author: Andy Rooney

quotes.text: The older I get, the smarter my parents become.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: The autumn of the body is the harvest of the soul.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: The greatest thing about getting old is that you don't lose all the other ages you have been.
quotes.author: Madeleine L'Engle

quotes.text: Life is a series of tiny miracles. Notice them.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: A story is a thing you build slowly over a long time. So is a life.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: The past is a place of learning, not a place of living.
quotes.author: Roy T. Bennett

quotes.text: It is not by muscle, speed, or physical dexterity that great things are achieved, but by reflection, force of character, and judgment.
quotes.author: Cicero

quotes.text: The best days are ordinary days shared with people you love.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: A long life is not a straight line — it is a garden of turns.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: The days you rest well are the days you remember well.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: Small joys become large in the golden years.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: The best strength of all is the ability to be kind to yourself.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: You are exactly the age you are — and that is exactly enough.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: There is a season for everything, and this one deserves your presence.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: Sit in the sun. Sip your tea. Everything else can wait.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: You have written a life worth reading — reread it often.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: The best mornings begin with sunlight, tea, and no rush.
quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.text: Every wrinkle is a chapter, and every chapter earned its space.
quotes.author: Anonymous
